# Triage Labels

<!-- Generated by Chartroom {{version}} on {{date}} from {{baseUrl}}. Do not edit by hand: re-run `chartroom adapter --write docs/agents` after changing a display label. -->

The skills speak in terms of five canonical triage roles. Chartroom uses the role name as the label id; the right-hand column is what this instance shows humans for it.

| Label in mattpocock/skills | Label in our tracker | Shown as | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `needs-triage` | `needs-triage` | {{triage:needs-triage}} | Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue |
| `needs-info` | `needs-info` | {{triage:needs-info}} | Waiting on reporter for more information |
| `ready-for-agent` | `ready-for-agent` | {{triage:ready-for-agent}} | Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent |
| `ready-for-human` | `ready-for-human` | {{triage:ready-for-human}} | Requires human implementation |
| `wontfix` | `wontfix` | {{triage:wontfix}} | Will not be actioned |

When a skill mentions a role (e.g. "apply the AFK-ready triage label"), pass the id from the middle column to `chartroom issue label add`. The five ids form the exclusive `triage-state` group; `bug` and `enhancement` form `triage-category`.

Do not edit the right-hand columns here; change the display label in the instance's admin settings and re-run `chartroom adapter --write docs/agents`.
